about: Strathroy-Caradoc is a municipality in Middlesex County, Ontario, west of London. Strathroy is the main urban centre; Caradoc’s farmland and smaller settlements surround it after amalgamation. The Sydenham River runs through town, and the community serves as a service hub for surrounding agriculture. About 24,000 people live in Strathroy-Caradoc.
